text:
Sophie (Partnerships): Heads up — reseller bundle for Polaris Devices is going to include a Redwood co-branded quickstart card and a peel-off sticker. Need final asset ownership and badge copy by EOD so fulfillment can start printing.
Liam (Design): Uploaded dieline + sticker proofs to the drive. Quick note — the sticker needs a 2mm bleed and we should use the horizontal lockup, not the stacked one. Link: https://drive.redwood/polaris/assets
Sophie (Partnerships): @Nina can legal confirm whether reseller can add their reseller badge next to ours? Also any required legal copy for the quickstart card (warranty, trademarks)?
Nina (Legal): Short answer: reseller badge ok with constraints. They must include the trademark footnote and not imply joint ownership. Provide this text on the card: "Redwood Inference is a registered trademark of Redwood Labs, Inc. Used under license." Also send me the final mock to sign off. :white_check_mark:
Arjun (Marketing): For the quickstart card copy: can we keep the headline: "Get started with Redwood on Polaris" and include the marketplace SKU + a short URL. Also want to confirm alt text for the sticker image for the marketplace listing.
Marcus (Hardware PM): Fulfillment deadline is Friday. We need print-ready PDFs by Wednesday COB. I'll hold a slot with the contract manufacturer but need sign-off from design + legal.
Liam (Design): FYI logo specs:``` 
svg: redwood-logo-horizontal.svg
lockup: redwood-polaris-lockup-v3.pdf
color: #FF4E4E (brand), #061A2B (navy)
min-clear: 12mm at print 300dpi
sticker-bleed: 2mm
```
Liam (Design): Also attached alternative sticker shapes — recommends rounded rectangle for peel adhesion.
Sophie (Partnerships): @AssetBot please attach final partner brand guidelines we received from Polaris — need to check their logo spacing rules against ours.
AssetBot: Attached: polaris-brand-guidelines-2025.pdf, polaris-reseller-badge.ai
Nina (Legal): One more legal flag — reseller may not add any endorsement language like "built by". Also include a line: "Polaris is a registered trademark of Polaris Instruments."
Arjun (Marketing): For marketplace tile we need: 1 hero 1200x628, 1 square 800x800, alt text: "Polaris server rack with Redwood Inference logo badge". Can design export PNG + web-optimized JPEG.
Liam (Design): Will export sizes; question on badge placement: do we center the lockup on the quickstart card or align left? Mocking both now.
Marcus (Hardware PM): Left align preferred for printer layout. Keeps barcode placement consistent.
Sophie (Partnerships): Great — next steps: 1) @Liam produce print-ready PDFs and web assets by Wed 5pm PST; 2) @Nina sign-off on mock; 3) @Arjun confirm final copy and SKU; 4) Marcus to confirm pickup slot. If anyone can't meet timeline flag now.
Nina (Legal): I'll review the mock as soon as Liam posts it, earliest by tomorrow morning.
Arjun (Marketing): I'll confirm SKU and short URL by EOD.
Liam (Design): Uploaded mock v1: https://drive.redwood/polaris/assets/mock_v1.pdf — ping me with :eyes: or direct edits.
Sophie (Partnerships): Thanks all — printing is on a tight calendar. :hourglass: If we get everything by Wed I'll coordinate with vendor.
Marcus (Hardware PM): Thx — reserving the print window.
Sophie (Partnerships): Closing the loop here when legal sign-off received.
